meta.title: Acme UI Review
meta.intro: I went through every page and window on a laptop screen and on a phone. Each finding shows the screen now (problem circled in red) next to a mock-up of the fix (change outlined in green). Under each one, pick Accept fix, the alternative, or write something else. I read your choices from this page before building.
strengths: The phone version of the Invoices list (one card per invoice) is the right pattern; other lists should copy it.
meta.foot: Screenshots come from a demo copy with made-up data. The “after” pictures are mock-ups: some names and figures in them are made up to show the idea.

areas.name: Across the app
areas.intro: Problems that show up on several pages.

items.title: Tabs are cut off on a phone
items.wrong: On a phone, the tab row runs off the right edge: the dashboard shows “Taxes anc”.
items.why: Nothing tells you there is more to the side, so people don't find the hidden tab.
items.fix: Shorter tab names on a phone, and a fade at the edge when they still don't fit.
items.alt: Replace the tabs with one dropdown on a phone.
